meta.frame: body: x forward, y left, z up; level body = world axes; origin = CAD origin
meta.angles: roll phi about +x, pitch theta about +y (small angles); reported in deg where *_deg

assumptions.F_min_basis: cylinder force (pressure x bore area) = superstructure weight share; contact force = cylinder force + rod weight

kinematics.note: extension e pushes the pad down so the body point rises by e: A q = e (rigid floor, all pads in contact)
kinematics.note_slope: crawler treated as a rigid box x[-1.840,1.844] y[-1.366,1.366] at z=-1.0509 (bbox of the crawler assembly in cad/parts_classified.csv); the crawler hangs from the body, so clearance is checked at its corners

time_step.rule: dt <= T_min / 50 (accuracy, >= 50 steps per period of the highest retained mode); stability of explicit contact needs dt < 2/omega_max

slope_V12.procedure: pads placed on the floor with zero spring force at the levelled extension, then gravity (linear statics)
slope_V12.contact_point: sphere of radius = ball height (ASSUMPTION 0.06 m) centred at the ball; force through the ball centre
